$comment: Generated by 'npm run factory -- compile 019'. Do not edit by hand, except to set an AC's passes/evidence from a green CI run.
title: The surface bundle is minified and held to a size budget in CI

tasks.title: Minified surface build and the size budget check
CI runs the budget check after the surface build

acs.text: WHEN the surface is built THE SYSTEM SHALL emit fully minified JavaScript (no indented lines, no `/*#__PURE__*/` annotations) and minified CSS, and the manifest SHALL still list every file with its integrity hash
scenarios: AC-001 the surface build is minified

acs.text: WHEN `npm run surface:budget` runs on a surface build that meets `app/surface-budget.json` THE SYSTEM SHALL print each file's raw and gzip size and the totals against their limits, and exit 0
scenarios: AC-002 a build within budget passes

acs.text: WHEN a build exceeds any budget (entry gzip, largest chunk gzip, total gzip, total raw, number of files) or a file the manifest lists is missing THE SYSTEM SHALL exit non-zero, naming the budget, the measured size, the limit and how to fix it
scenarios: AC-003 a build over budget fails with the fix

acs.text: WHEN ci.yml's `build` job runs THE SYSTEM SHALL run the budget check right after the surface build
scenarios: AC-004 CI runs the budget check
